---
title: "Overall survival, unadjusted — results"
subtitle: "Survival curves, 182-day RMST, survival probabilities and hazard ratios"
format: html
---

- No RMST for unrestricted follow-up.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggdist)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))
source(here("R", "posterior.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", "09-unadjusted", "results")
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
n_draws <- config$posterior_draws$main

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  mutate(tx_plot = group_factor(tx))
max_follow_up <- max(cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted)

# Prediction seeds: the fit seeds + 50.
models <- tribble(
  ~model, ~label, ~follow_up, ~seed_offset,
  "ph-182", "Proportional hazards, 182 days", "182", 150,
  "nph-182", "Time-varying hazard ratio, 182 days", "182", 250,
  "ph-unrestricted", "Proportional hazards, unrestricted follow-up", "unrestricted", 350,
  "nph-unrestricted", "Time-varying hazard ratio, unrestricted follow-up", "unrestricted", 450
) |>
  mutate(
    curve_horizon = if_else(follow_up == "182", horizon_days, max_follow_up),
    seed = config$seeds$survival + seed_offset,
    fit = map(model, \(model) {
      readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "models", sprintf("model-%s.rds", model)))
    })
  )
```

## Survival curves

```{r}
#| label: survival-curves
#| include: false

# Without covariates, the curve of one patient is the standardized curve.
# Same seed for both groups, so each draw pairs ctDNA and usual-care curves.
curves <- models |>
  select(model, fit, curve_horizon, seed) |>
  pmap(\(model, fit, curve_horizon, seed) {
    posterior_standardized_survival_draws(
      fit,
      tibble(tx = 0),
      horizon = curve_horizon,
      n_points = 200L,
      n_draws = n_draws,
      seed = seed
    ) |>
      mutate(tx = as.integer(tx), model = model)
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

curve_summary <- curves |>
  summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower = quantile(survival, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper = quantile(survival, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = c(model, tx, time)
  )

walk(models$model, \(model) {
  write_parquet(
    curve_summary |>
      filter(model == !!model) |>
      select(tx, time, median, lower, upper),
    file.path(results_dir, sprintf("survival-curves-%s.parquet", model)),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
})
```

## RMST at 182 days

```{r}
#| label: rmst
#| include: false

rmst_draws <- curves |>
  filter(model %in% c("ph-182", "nph-182")) |>
  compute_rmst_draws(horizon = horizon_days, group_cols = c("tx", "model")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = rmst, names_prefix = "rmst_") |>
  arrange(model, draw) |>
  mutate(rmst_diff = rmst_1 - rmst_0)

stopifnot(
  "Treatment and control draws could not be matched." =
    nrow(rmst_draws) == 2L * n_draws && !anyNA(rmst_draws)
)

rmst_summary <- rmst_draws |>
  summarise(
    summarize_posterior_draws(rmst_diff),
    probability_benefit = posterior_probability(rmst_diff),
    # q columns above are type-8 quantiles; the ci_* bounds are type-7.
    ci_66_low = quantile(rmst_diff, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    ci_66_high = quantile(rmst_diff, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_low = quantile(rmst_diff, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_high = quantile(rmst_diff, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = model
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rope_low = -7,
    rope_high = 7,
    rope_66_contains = ci_66_low >= rope_low & ci_66_high <= rope_high,
    horizon_days = horizon_days
  )

write_parquet(rmst_draws, file.path(results_dir, "rmst-draws.parquet"), compression = "zstd")
write_parquet(rmst_summary, file.path(results_dir, "rmst-summary.parquet"), compression = "zstd")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rmst
#| tbl-cap: "Unadjusted difference in 182-day RMST (ctDNA − usual care), days"
#| echo: false

kable(rmst_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Survival at 182 and 365 days

```{r}
#| label: survival-rates
#| include: false

# Survival exactly at each horizon (the unrestricted curve grid need not
# contain it), with the curve seed so that the draws match the curves.
survival_draws <- models |>
  cross_join(tibble(horizon = c(horizon_days, 365L))) |>
  filter(horizon <= curve_horizon) |>
  select(model, fit, horizon, seed) |>
  pmap(\(model, fit, horizon, seed) {
    posterior_standardized_survival_draws(
      fit,
      tibble(tx = 0),
      horizon = horizon,
      n_points = 2L,
      n_draws = n_draws,
      seed = seed
    ) |>
      filter(time == horizon) |>
      mutate(tx = as.integer(tx), model = model, horizon_days = horizon)
  }) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(model, horizon_days, draw),
    names_from = tx,
    values_from = survival,
    names_prefix = "survival_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    risk_difference = survival_1 - survival_0,
    risk_ratio = survival_1 / survival_0
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(survival_draws))

survival_rates_summary <- survival_draws |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(survival_0, survival_1),
    names_to = "tx",
    names_prefix = "survival_",
    names_transform = as.integer,
    values_to = "survival"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower_95 = quantile(survival, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper_95 = quantile(survival, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = c(model, horizon_days, tx)
  )

survival_difference_summary <- survival_draws |>
  summarise(
    median = median(risk_difference),
    lower_66 = quantile(risk_difference, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    upper_66 = quantile(risk_difference, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    lower_95 = quantile(risk_difference, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper_95 = quantile(risk_difference, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(risk_difference > 0),
    .by = c(model, horizon_days)
  )

write_parquet(survival_draws, file.path(results_dir, "survival-draws.parquet"), compression = "zstd")
write_parquet(
  survival_rates_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "survival-rates-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  survival_difference_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "survival-difference-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-survival-difference
#| tbl-cap: "Unadjusted survival difference (ctDNA − usual care) at 182 and 365 days"
#| echo: false

kable(survival_difference_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Hazard ratios

```{r}
#| label: hazard-ratios
#| include: false

# Draws subsampled with the prediction seed + 25.
hazard_ratio_draws <- models |>
  filter(str_starts(model, "ph")) |>
  select(model, fit, seed) |>
  pmap(\(model, fit, seed) {
    coefficient_draws <- as.matrix(fit, pars = "tx")
    set.seed(seed + 25)
    selected_draws <- sample(seq_len(nrow(coefficient_draws)), n_draws)

    tibble(
      model = model,
      draw = seq_len(n_draws),
      log_hazard_ratio = coefficient_draws[selected_draws, 1],
      hazard_ratio = exp(log_hazard_ratio)
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

hazard_ratio_summary <- hazard_ratio_draws |>
  summarise(
    median = median(hazard_ratio),
    ci_66_low = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    ci_66_high = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_low = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_high = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(hazard_ratio < 1),
    draws = n(),
    .by = model
  )

write_parquet(
  hazard_ratio_draws,
  file.path(results_dir, "hazard-ratio-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  hazard_ratio_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "hazard-ratio-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-hazard-ratios
#| tbl-cap: "Unadjusted treatment hazard ratio, ctDNA versus usual care"
#| echo: false

kable(hazard_ratio_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: build-plots
#| include: false

km_fits <- list(
  "182" = survfit2(
    Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~ tx_plot,
    data = cohort,
    conf.type = "log-log"
  ),
  unrestricted = survfit2(
    Surv(survival_time_days_unrestricted, status_death_unrestricted) ~ tx_plot,
    data = cohort,
    conf.type = "log-log"
  )
)

survival_plots <- models |>
  select(model, follow_up, curve_horizon) |>
  pmap(\(model, follow_up, curve_horizon) {
    plot_km_model(
      km_fits[[follow_up]],
      filter(curve_summary, model == !!model),
      x_max = curve_horizon,
      risk_every = if (follow_up == "182") 50 else 100
    )
  }) |>
  set_names(models$model)

iwalk(survival_plots, \(plot, model) {
  save_figure(
    ggsurvfit_build(plot),
    file.path(figure_dir, sprintf("kaplan-meier-vs-posterior-model-%s.png", model)),
    height = 6.5
  )
})

model_labels <- set_names(models$label, models$model)

rmst_plot <- rmst_draws |>
  transmute(draw = rmst_diff, panel = factor(model_labels[model], levels = models$label)) |>
  plot_posterior(
    x_label = paste0(
      "Difference in ", horizon_days,
      "-day restricted mean survival time (ctDNA − usual care), days"
    )
  )

hazard_ratio_plot <- hazard_ratio_draws |>
  transmute(draw = hazard_ratio, panel = factor(model_labels[model], levels = models$label)) |>
  plot_posterior(
    x_label = "Hazard ratio, ctDNA versus usual care",
    reference = 1,
    log_scale = TRUE
  )

save_figure(rmst_plot, file.path(figure_dir, "rmst-difference-posterior.png"), height = 6)
save_figure(hazard_ratio_plot, file.path(figure_dir, "hazard-ratio-posterior.png"), height = 6)

time_varying_plots <- models |>
  filter(str_starts(model, "nph")) |>
  select(model, fit) |>
  deframe() |>
  map(plot_time_varying_hr)

iwalk(time_varying_plots, \(plot, model) {
  save_figure(plot, file.path(figure_dir, sprintf("tve-plot-%s.png", model)))
})
```
